formula.elevation: elevation in about -0.9 (narrow, far from the camera) .. +1.0 (wide, near the camera)

use.draw: draw each kart sprite scaled by kart_scale at its current s (linearly interpolate between samples, smooth with about 0.15 s)
use.hitbox: scale the kart collision circle/capsule by kart_scale as well
use.hazards: scale hazards by the kart_scale at their own s
use.lateral_limit: lateral offset limit on the road = half_width - kart_half_width*kart_scale
use.speed: speed is NOT changed by the scale; optionally add +/-3 % per 0.1 kart_scale for feel

layers.note: layer 1 = overpass decks (idx in layer1_ranges); karts with layer 1 draw after deck_overlay, layer 0 karts draw before it
